```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(corrplot)
library(GGally)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
nfl_cleaned <- read_csv("nfl_cleaned.csv")
head(nfl_cleaned)
```

```{r}
nfl_numeric <- nfl_cleaned %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))
head(nfl_numeric)
```

```{r}
cor(nfl_numeric)
```

```{r}
cols <- as.numeric(as.factor(nfl_cleaned$Win_Loss))

pairs(nfl_numeric, col = cols)
```

```{r}
correlations <- cor(nfl_numeric)
corrplot(correlations)
```

```{r}
ggpairs(nfl_numeric, progress = FALSE)
```

```{r}
cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(correlations), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rename(x_var = Var1) %>%
  rename(y_var = Var2) %>%
  rename(cor = Freq)

high_cor_75 <- cor_df %>%
  filter(x_var < y_var) %>%
  filter(abs(cor) >= 0.75)

x_cols75 <- high_cor_75$x_var
y_cols75 <- high_cor_75$y_var

plots75 <- map2(x_cols75, y_cols75, ~
  ggplot(nfl_cleaned, aes(x = .data[[.x]], y = .data[[.y]], colour = Win_Loss)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(x = .x, y = .y,
         title = paste(.x, "vs", .y)) +
    theme_minimal()
)
plots75
```

```{r}
high_cor_50 <- cor_df %>%
  filter(x_var < y_var) %>%
  filter(abs(cor) >= 0.50 & abs(cor) < 0.75)

x_cols50 <- high_cor_50$x_var
y_cols50 <- high_cor_50$y_var

plots50 <- map2(x_cols50, y_cols50, ~
  ggplot(nfl_cleaned, aes(x = .data[[.x]], y = .data[[.y]], colour = Win_Loss)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(x = .x, y = .y,
         title = paste(.x, "vs", .y)) +
    theme_minimal()
)
plots50
```
